title: DirectorPlan
description: The sole output contract of the AI Director layer. Produced by any ILLMProvider implementation (Claude today, any other LLM later) via structured/tool-call output validated against this schema. Nothing downstream ever talks back to the LLM directly - everything consumes this document.

logline.description: One or two sentence summary of the whole video.

negative_prompt_global.description: Applied to every shot unless overridden.

generated_by.description: Provenance of which LLM provider produced this plan - for audit and A/B comparison, never a hard dependency.
